acceptedAnswer.text: A mother-in-law apartment is a self-contained residential living area located on the same property as a single-family home. It typically includes its own sleeping quarters, full bathroom, living space, and often a kitchenette or full kitchen, along with an independent entrance. Depending on your property layout, these suites can be built as an interior conversion such as a transformed garage, an attached home addition sharing a wall with the main house, or a completely detached accessory dwelling unit (ADU). Establishing whether your space requires separate utility meters or specialized accessibility features like walk-in showers is a primary decision factor during early project planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: A mother-in-law apartment is a self-contained living suite on a residential property featuring a bedroom, bathroom, living area, and private entrance for extended family or guests.
